zh-CN.title: Agent Hint 协议下发
zh-CN.description: 按 Agent Hint 协议 v1.0，在每条主线模型请求上发送 X-Agent-Hint 头（会话身份、生命周期、优先级、缓存意图），并通过独立管理请求下发 pause/resume/stop/compact。请求体保持不变。

usage.title: 在 config.yaml 启用
usage.description: 把插件加入 plugins: 块并重启 Gateway。可选配置优先级、缓存、模型白名单与管理端点。

usage.title: 查看运行状态
usage.description: 访问 GET /api/extension/agent-hints/status 查看注入自检结果、会话计数、隔离会话与管理请求统计。

en-US.title: Agent Hint sender
en-US.description: Sends an X-Agent-Hint header on every main-line model request (session identity, lifecycle state, priority, cache intent) and emits pause/resume/stop/compact as dedicated manage requests. The request body is never touched.

usage.title: Enable in config.yaml
usage.description: Add the plugin to the plugins: block and restart the Gateway. Priority, cache, model filters and the manage endpoint are configurable.

usage.title: Inspect runtime status
usage.description: GET /api/extension/agent-hints/status reports the injection self-check, session counters, quarantined sessions and manage outcomes.
